results.title: Differential Associations of Excellencism and Perfectionism with Mental Health O
results.reason: This study examines excellencism and perfectionism in relation to mental health outcomes among licensure examinees, which has direct relevance to clinical psychology practice, particularly in assessment and intervention for high-stress professional settings.
